preconditions.description: The first line of stdin contains an integer T, and the total number of lines is exactly 1 + 2*T, representing T test cases where each case has two lines.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(line.strip()) <= 1000 and all('a' <= c <= 'z' for c in line.strip()) for line in stdin_lines[1:])
preconditions.description: For every test case, strings A and B consist only of lowercase alphabets and have lengths between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout_lines) == T and all(line in ['Yes', 'No'] for line in stdout_lines)
postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, each being either 'Yes' or 'No'.

postconditions.expression: all((set(A) & set(B) != set()) == (stdout_lines[i] == 'Yes') for i, (A, B) in enumerate(zip(stdin_lines[1::2], stdin_lines[2::2])) if A and B)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is 'Yes' if and only if there exists at least one character common to both string A and string B; otherwise, the output is 'No'.
